다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 우리말 뜻이 어색한 것은?

The first webcam was invented to watch a coffee pot. In 1991, Dr. Quentin Stafford-Fraser and Dr. Paul Jardetzky were working at a computer lab in England. ⓐTo work better, they needed lots of coffee. However, there was only one coffee machine in the building. So, they ⓑhad to make many disappointing trips to the empty coffee pot.
ⓒAs a solution, the two researchers set up a camera ⓓin front of the coffee machine. The camera took pictures of the coffee pot three times a minute. With special software, all the researchers in the building could see the pictures on their local network. No more ⓔdisappointing trips!

options: 탐보라산 폭발 이후, 농작물이 자라지 못해서 먹을 음식이 충분하지 못했다.
탐보라산 폭발 이후, 많은 말들이 식용으로 죽임을 당했고, 새로운 이동 수단이 필요했다.
1817년 독일에서 나무로 된 네 개의 바퀴가 있는 최초의 자전거가 발명되었다.
최초의 자전거는 페달 없이 발로 자전거를 앞으로 밀어야 했다.
questions.question:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

Mt. Tambora, a volcano in Indonesia, exploded in 1815. The explosion created a huge cloud of ash, so crops failed around the world. As a result, people didn't have enough food to eat. Surprisingly, this made traveling difficult. Why? In those days, people rode horses, but many horses were killed for food.
People needed a new way to travel, and Karl von Drais invented the first bicycle in Germany in 1817. Drais's bicycle had two wooden wheels but no pedals. How did it move without pedals? Well, riders simply pushed the bicycle forward with their feet. The present-day bicycle is the result of many inventors' work in the 19th century.
